purpose: Define the minimum governed intake contract before any agent generates application code.

domain_position.domain: UPI failed transaction and dispute resolution case management

acceptance_criteria: Every generated requirement must identify whether it is synthetic, mock-boundary, or missing official source.
Every external dependency must be represented through a mock adapter.
No requirement may claim official UPI, NPCI, RBI, bank, PSP, switch, or settlement compliance unless an approved official source is attached in a future phase.
Human review feedback must be accepted, stored, and audit-linked.
